summary_en: This study tests lattice radiation therapy (LRT) in people with large, bulky solid tumors that are locally advanced or metastatic. LRT is given in 5 fractions; the total treatment length and the time between fractions are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes this as a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba la radioterapia en celosía (LRT) en personas con tumores sólidos grandes y voluminosos que están localmente avanzados o son metastásicos. La LRT se administra en 5 fracciones; la duración total del tratamiento y el tiempo entre fracciones no se indican. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica; el registro describe un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Solid tumor with a clinical indication for radiation
Has a target lesion that suits a lattice therapy plan
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or lower, life expectancy over 3 months
Agrees to avoid pregnancy and can sign written consent
not_for: Received cytotoxic chemotherapy or known radiosensitizing agents within 5 days before or after lattice therapy
Has a blood cancer (such as lymphoma or leukemia) or a primary or metastatic brain or spinal cord cancer
Has a history of conditions that increase radiation toxicity or a known contraindication to radiation
Has uncontrolled illness that is not related to the cancer
